title: Lock stage
description: A full-window stage on the paper for a 3D scene without a frame. The title and its text float at the top of the stage (Top), stand in a column on the left (Left), or open the module with a large title (Hero); a note can sit at the bottom right, over the scene. On narrow screens everything stacks.
instructions: Put one free object with aspectRatio fill in Scene. Top: keep the text to two short lines. Left: the column takes up to 36rem (a dialogue fits). The object keeps its subject out of the part the text covers (safe area).

arrangement.title: Text placement
arrangement.description: Top: the text floats over the top of the stage. Left: a column of text on the left, from the top. Hero: a larger title in a column on the left, centred in height (opening screens).
